segments.prompt: sunset in the Australian outback, three exhausted stickman soldiers in khaki slouch hats and the moustached stickman Major slumped on empty wooden ammunition crates next to an old army truck, one waving a small white flag, while a crowd of emus celebrates behind them, one emu wearing a soldier's slouch hat.
